title: Employment (Amendment) Act 2022
topic: labour standards; foreign employees; domestic work
in_force: by ministerial notification (s. 1(2)); the site records 1 January 2023, gazette notice not seen
source_tier: official print (Laws of Malaysia, Percetakan Nasional Malaysia Berhad; copy supplied by IMR)
site_status: ON SITE (domestic-laws: recorded as the 2022 amendment of Act 265)
note: Checked on 2026-11-21 against the official print. Royal Assent 26 April 2022; published in the Gazette 10 May 2022. Replaces "domestic servant" with "domestic employee", substitutes s. 60K (prior approval to employ a foreign employee) and adds s. 60KA (termination of a foreign employee must be reported), among other changes. No official web link yet: lom.agc.gov.my refuses our crawler (follow-up item 273).

title: Employees' Minimum Standards of Housing, Accommodations and Amenities Act 1990
title_original: Akta Standard Minimum Perumahan, Penginapan dan Kemudahan Pekerja 1990
in_force: Peninsular Malaysia 1 December 1990 (P.U. (B) 114/1991); Federal Territory of Labuan 1 June 2020 (P.U. (B) 248/2020)
source_tier: official reprint (Commissioner of Law Revision, Malaysia; reprint as at 1 February 2021; copy supplied by IMR)
note: Checked on 2026-11-21 against the official reprint as at 1 February 2021. Royal Assent 22 August 1990; published in the Gazette 30 August 1990. Act A1604 changed the short title (formerly the Workers' Minimum Standards of Housing and Amenities Act 1990) and applied the Act to the Federal Territory of Labuan (1 June 2020). Part II (housing) does not apply inside city or municipal council areas unless the Minister orders it (s. 2). The site row matches (amended 2019). No official web link yet: lom.agc.gov.my refuses our crawler.
